title: Source that allows insecure connections
description: nuget.config declares an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true.
limitation: It matches an `allowInsecureConnections` switch set to true in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
